mods.description:
An older NSFW edit for Alarielle: a clothing model with less coverage plus her two model definitions. A stronger 90% version by the same author exists; use one of them.

ATB's asset pack replaces the same two model definitions, so with Alarielle, Temptation's Bloom only one of the two looks can win, depending on the load order. Last updated in 2022.

mods.description:
A Chinese reskin from 2022 that gives Valkia a new head, built from Miao Ying's storm-dragon human-form head and hair textures. Because the pack carries those Miao Ying textures under their original names, it also changes Miao Ying's look in her human form and clashes with Miao Ying reskins.

Steam comments disagree on whether it still works after recent patches.

mods.description:
Gives the corrupted White Lions unit from Corrupted Landmarks a new look based on Endo's corrupted elf models. The pack only contains models and textures (95 files) and names Mixu's Unlocker as a dependency; the Workshop page lists Corrupted Landmarks as required, which also provides most of the textures it refers to.

The ZZZ and ZZZ_alt uploads replace exactly the same files, so use one of them. Uploaded by [GWD]Dean; the pack names follow Readman's naming for ATB submods.
